summary: A major Sydney property developer has collapsed, leaving buyers in limbo as the construction sector faces ongoing instability. Western Australia is moving to scrap character references in criminal sentencing, marking a shift in how courts approach sentencing decisions. Coles has posted a $1.1 billion annual profit while setting aside $235 million for worker underpayments, highlighting ongoing wage compliance issues in the retail sector.
